verdict.rationale: Vercel documents its own firewall capability that blocks attacks with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets, which covers the WAF half of the story. The evidence never mentions DDoS mitigation or says protection applies to every request by default. Bot-protection items are an adjacent feature and earn no credit, and one community comment about undetected DDoS is too vague to create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented DDoS protection, evidence the WAF and DDoS protection are on by default for all requests, depth on managed rulesets, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default

citations.quote: Block attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets.
